duplication.note: rev-list --objects emits each reachable sha once, so unique_blob_count == n_blob_objects. Duplication is many unique hashes at one path (append-only logs) plus zlib/pack compression of similar JSON.

All 76 tags and every branch containing 801c98b67 would move. Downstream clones would be rewritten. Do not force-push. Do not delete branches as part of executing this plan.

restore: Verify recovery HEAD matches the recorded pre-rewrite SHA before replacing any live remote.
rollback.why_bundle_and_mirror: A bundle is a single-file snapshot of every ref. A mirror clone preserves refs/ exactly. Keep both. The previous filter-repo run (2026-07-01) left .git/filter-repo/commit-map — a second rewrite composes and that map is not a rollback.
